mass_basis: operator-reported installed load; inclusion of holder/attachment mass unconfirmed
scope: Attended autonomous base on dry concrete, held folded pose, operator at physical motor-power stop; 1 m forward test corridor. No arm motion. Not a maximum payload rating.
speed_definition: Maximum guarded command; every eligible nominal window independently covers at least 90 percent of the requested ground speed.

measurement.method: Independent masked raw-LiDAR point-to-line registration with unchanged covariance and angular-sector observability checks, stationary repeatability, 15 percent scale reserve, 1 mm numerical reserve and bounded stationary-reference alignment error. Fixed validated scan views stay locked through each pulse and stop.
measurement.blind_excursion: Hardware point-speed envelope times capture gap / 2; replaces the smaller pure-command stage bound conservatively for all recorded windows.
measurement.hardware_model_source: HARDWARE.md speed modes: approximately 0.4 m/s and 90 degrees/s; circumscribed body radius 0.33 m; 15 percent reserve.
